name: Log HTTP Response Time (Cronsole)
description: Time how long a URL takes to respond and fail the run when it is slower than your threshold, so a degraded endpoint shows up as a trend rather than only as a hard outage.

parameters.label: URL
parameters.help: The endpoint to time with an HTTP GET.

parameters.label: Fail above (ms)
parameters.help: Record the run as failed when the response takes longer than this many milliseconds.
